title: Full battery screen for NERV: MCP Apps page or link
goal: NERV can open FPVBuddy's full battery screen without a copy of it
acceptance: FPVBuddy's MCP server provides an MCP Apps UI page for the battery view, or, if MCP Apps does not fit, a stable link to FPVBuddy's own page; the choice and reason are in the record
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface type or page bricks lacks goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local copy in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one page on the bricks battery view. Not a measurement.
